character.name: Zorion Voss
traits: Mastermind Strategist: Can map out social and combat scenarios several steps ahead, identifying weaknesses in any plan or person.
Silver-Tongued Manipulator: Can lie, charm, or intimidate with ease, detecting others' insecurities to exploit them.
Empathy Void: Feels no remorse, guilt, or compassion for others, viewing all people as tools to be used.
Network Weaver: Excels at building webs of obligation, using guilt and fear to bind others to his will.
character.gear: Leather armor · Shortsword · Thieves' tools · 3 Field rations · Healing potion · Ornate Varrick signet ring · 50ft silk rope · Wolfsbane poison vial
character.story: Zorion was raised in the gilded cages of the capital's nobility, where smiles hide daggers and loyalty is a commodity. By twelve, he framed his kind tutor for theft just to watch him hauled to the gallows, feeling only cold satisfaction. Now a disgraced exile, he weaves a web of guilt and fear across the city's power brokers, pulling strings from the shadows. His first victim still haunts his dreams—not with regret, but with the memory of how sweet their ruin tasted.

inventory.name: Shortsword
inventory.lore: A slender, well-balanced shortsword taken from a disgraced dueling master Zorion ruined in his youth. The hilt is etched with the sigil of his former noble house, a reminder of the power he once wielded over others.
inventory.description: A fine steel shortsword, sharp enough to slide between ribs with minimal resistance.

inventory.name: Leather Armor
inventory.lore: Soft, supple leather dyed the deep burgundy of his family's house. It was tailored for him as a coming-of-age gift, before he orchestrated the scandal that destroyed his father's reputation.
inventory.description: Fitted burgundy leather armor, reinforced at the joints to allow silent movement.

inventory.name: Thieves' Tools
inventory.lore: A set of lockpicks and tension wrenches stolen from the palace's master locksmith after Zorion framed him for theft. Each pick is marked with a tiny notch only he recognizes, a signature of his work.
inventory.description: A compact set of finely crafted lockpicks, tension wrenches, and small probes for disarming traps.
inventory.effects: Advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to pick locks or disarm traps.

inventory.name: Field Rations
inventory.lore: Dried, salted meat and hardtack stolen from the palace armory during his escape. Each ration is stamped with the royal seal, a small reminder of the power he stole from the crown.
inventory.description: Staple travel rations, nutritious but tasteless.
inventory.effects: Restores 1d4+1 hit points when consumed, and provides enough sustenance for a full day of travel.

inventory.name: Healing Potion
inventory.lore: A potion brewed by the court alchemist, a man Zorion blackmailed into making it for him before he left the city. The liquid glows faintly red, like the blood of the man he ruined to extract the recipe.
inventory.description: A crystal vial filled with a shimmering red liquid that smells faintly of rosemary and iron.

inventory.name: Ornate Varrick Signet Ring
inventory.lore: The signet ring of House Varrick, his family's disgraced noble line. Zorion keeps it as a trophy after framing his elder brother for his own crimes, stripping the house of all its titles and wealth.
inventory.description: A heavy gold ring set with a deep red garnet, engraved with the coiled serpent sigil of House Varrick.
inventory.effects: Once per day, can cast Charm Person (save DC 13) by pressing the ring to a target's forehead. The target has advantage on the saving throw if they are aware of House Varrick's downfall.

inventory.name: 50ft Silk Rope
inventory.lore: A length of silk rope stolen from the palace's treasury. It is strong enough to hold a grown man's weight, and silent enough to use for stealthy ascents or, as Zorion has used it before, to silence a witness permanently.
inventory.description: A smooth, lightweight silk rope, woven tightly to resist fraying and knots.

inventory.name: Wolfsbane Poison Vial
inventory.lore: A concentrated extract of wolfsbane purchased from a back-alley apothecary in the city's underbelly. Zorion used the last of his previous supply to eliminate a rival merchant who threatened to expose his schemes.
inventory.description: A small glass vial filled with a thick, dark green liquid that smells faintly of almonds.
inventory.effects: When applied to a weapon, the next hit deals an extra 1d4 poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.
